title: ESC die temperature in flight
finding: The 8 inch on 8S reaches 116 C; the other three flights stay between 52.6 and 87.4 C.

caveats.text: The die sensor is the ESC's own; ESC model and cooling are not in the log.
Flight length, load and ambient temperature differ between the airframes, so the curves are not a like-for-like comparison.
A flight log from one day, not a flight controller bench measurement; no FC bench capture exists.
The flights are the hottest of the retained logs, not typical flights; the retained logs are a selection of 103.
